visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism (The 'Crystal' Variant) - DO NOT use full transparency for elements having content below them. Use bg-slate-800/40 or rgba(30,41,59,0.4) combined with backdrop-blur-xl and border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.grain: Apply subtle noise texture overlay on the background via a fixed div with opacity-5 and pointer-events-none.
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)] for floating cards, soft inner strokes (border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.micro_animations: Hover states must have translate-y-[-2px] with scale-100 to scale-[1.02] for interactive elements. Transition config: transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out.

layouts.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid for Dashboards.
layouts.spacing: Generous inner padding for cards (p-6 or p-8). Avoid cramped layouts.
layouts.navigation: Sticky Header with backdrop blur. Sidebar for multi-role navigation. Generous footer.

instructor_roster.style: Glassmorphism rows, hover:bg-white/5. Badges for Code 8/Code 10 using accent #10b981 with dark text. Progress bars with #1D6A4A fill and #0f172a track.
instructor_roster.modals: Feedback Modal with backdrop-blur-2xl glass overlay. Solid modal body (bg-slate-900) to ensure readability.

calendar_slot_scheduler.style: Glass cards for individual slots. Neon green borders for 'Available' slots, deep green for 'Booked'. Add Slot modal.

instructor_profile.style: Bento grid style. Rating 4.8/5.0 highlighted with neon green glow. Total hours 142 Hrs inside large typographic cards.

header.style: Header MUST have backdrop-blur and semi-transparent bg (not fully transparent) to prevent text collision. User Avatar included for 'Lesego Lebese - Technical Lead'.

footer.style: Footer containing CPUT Faculty branding, with high contrast typography.

icons.rules: Use stroke-width 1.5. Sizes typically w-5 h-5 or w-6 h-6.

image_urls.description: Close-up of hands on a steering wheel. Use for Login page with dark overlay.
Dark empty road at night. Good for mood-setting background panels or instructor dashboard header.
Driving a BMW. Can be cropped for the avatar or used in the profile header context.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text (#f8fafc) on glass/navy backgrounds has minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, modals, table rows) MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure you use .js/.jsx extensions for all React components, not .tsx. The setup is JS based.
Configure Tailwind config colors to include base '#0f172a', primary '#1D6A4A', and accent '#10b981'.
In index.css, add imports for 'Outfit' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' from Google Fonts.
Implement the 'Modern Dark Glassmorphism' theme. Set body background to #0f172a.
Cards should use: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)].
Badges (Code 8/10) should be bg-[#10b981] text-[#022c22] px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider.
Do not center-align the app container. Left-align dashboard content.
Do not use generic Inter/Roboto fonts for headings. Use 'Outfit' for all headings and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body.
Ensure Header has a background (e.g., bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur), DO NOT use completely transparent background.
Header must include avatar for 'Lesego Lebese - Technical Lead'. Footer must have 'CPUT Faculty' branding.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Avoid using generic transitions like 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions.
Add sonner for toast notifications. Example `yarn add sonner`.
Follow the High Density Grid (MODE B) strategy for the dashboard structure.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
